question: Russia-Ukraine Ceasefire before GTA VI?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if  if there is an official ceasefire agreement, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed halt in military engagement, between Russia and Ukraine before Grand Theft Auto VI is officially released in the US. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If neither occurs by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source for the release of GTA VI is official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

Only ceasefires which constitute a general pause in the conflict will qualify. Ceasefires which only apply to energy infrastructure, the Black Sea, or other similar agreements will not qualify.

Any form of informal agreement will not be considered an official ceasefire. Humanitarian pauses will not count toward the resolution of this market.

The resolution for a ceasefire will be based on official announcements from both Russia and Ukraine; however, a wide consensus of credible media reporting stating an official ceasefire agreement between Russia and Ukraine has been reached will suffice.

events.title: What will happen before GTA VI?
events.description: This is a market on predicting events that will occur before the release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket heavily favors Drake releasing his long-teased Iceman album before GTA VI's November 19, 2026 launch, pricing it at an 86% implied probability amid $21 million in volume. This reflects Drake's March 29 confirmation during Nelly Furtado's Hall of Fame induction that the project is "coming soon," coupled with ongoing teasers from producers, Adin Ross streams hinting at snippets, and DJ Akademiks' reports of an imminent drop—contrasting Rockstar Games' radio silence since the November 2025 delay announcement. Other music outcomes like new Playboi Carti or Rihanna albums trail at 55-56%, buoyed by similar rollout buzz, while geopolitical and crypto bets hover around 50%. Take-Two Interactive's mid-May earnings call looms as a key catalyst for GTA VI marketing updates, such as Trailer 3 timing, though entertainment release schedules remain fluid.

question: Will Harvey Weinstein be sentenced to no prison time?
description:
This market will resolve according to the prison sentence, if any, imposed on Harvey Weinstein as part of his ongoing New York retrial (People of the State of New York v. Harvey Weinstein) by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

This market will resolve immediately based on the first sentence rendered in this case, regardless of any appeals. If Weinstein is found not guilty, there is a mistrial, or if the first sentencing does not include any jail or prison time, this market will resolve to "No Prison Time."

If no sentencing takes place by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will also resolve to "No Prison Time."

If the sentence falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

For the purposes of this market, it does not matter whether the sentence is concurrent or consecutive to any existing sentence Weinstein is already serving. The market will resolve based on the total prison sentence imposed in this case.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the New York court system or other involved U.S. government sources; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket tilts slightly toward "No Prison Time" at 33.3% implied probability for disgraced Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein, driven by his history of successful appeals—including the 2024 overturn of his original 23-year New York sentence—and recent plea discussions to resolve an unresolved third-degree rape charge. Currently incarcerated at Rikers Island pending a third Manhattan retrial starting April 14, Weinstein faces a upheld 2025 criminal sex act conviction alongside a 16-year consecutive California sexual assault sentence he's appealing, creating tight competition with 20-30 years (26.7%) and 10-20 years (20%). This market will resolve immediately based on the first sentence rendered in this case, regardless of any appeals. If Weinstein is found not guilty, there is a mistrial, or if the first sentencing does not include any jail or prison time, this market will resolve to "No Prison Time."

If no sentencing takes place by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will also resolve to "No Prison Time."

For the purposes of this market, it does not matter whether the sentence is concurrent or consecutive to any existing sentence Weinstein is already serving. The market will resolve based on the total prison sentence imposed in this case.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the New York court system or other involved U.S. government sources; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket tilts slightly toward "No Prison Time" at 33.3% implied probability for disgraced Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein, driven by his history of successful appeals—including the 2024 overturn of his original 23-year New York sentence—and recent plea discussions to resolve an unresolved third-degree rape charge. Currently incarcerated at Rikers Island pending a third Manhattan retrial starting April 14, Weinstein faces a upheld 2025 criminal sex act conviction alongside a 16-year consecutive California sexual assault sentence he's appealing, creating tight competition with 20-30 years (26.7%) and 10-20 years (20%). At 74, his frail health and complaints of "hellish" prison conditions add upset potential via compassionate release or mistrial, though prosecutors push for extended time in this enduring #MeToo reckoning.

question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will resolve to “No” if it becomes impossible for this team to win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup based off the rules of the NHL.

The resolution source for this market will be information from the NHL.

events.title: 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Champion
events.description: This market is to predict the winner of the 2025–26 NHL Stanley Cup championship.

eventMetadata.context_description: Colorado Avalanche lead trader consensus at 20.1% implied probability to win the 2026 Stanley Cup, driven by their Presidents' Trophy-clinching 52-16-10 record after a  April 9 victory over Calgary, securing home-ice throughout playoffs. Tampa Bay Lightning follow at 15.6% on nine straight postseason berths and playoff-tested core with Kucherov and Point heating up, despite fourth in East standings. Carolina Hurricanes sit at 12.5% as recent Metro Division clinchers with a 51-22-6 mark and elite power play. Dallas Stars (8.0%) and Edmonton Oilers (7.0%) keep the top bunch competitive amid wild card chaos and post-March trade deadline depth additions, highlighting playoff unpredictability with brackets set for April 18 start.
